hero.headline: Roofing, siding and home remodeling in Birdsboro, done honestly.
hero.subhead: Roofs, siding, gutters, windows, doors, kitchens and bathrooms from a family-owned remodeler with 20 years in the trade. Tell us about the project and get a free estimate.

skyeGreeting: Hi, I'm the DiPaulo's Home Remodeling assistant. Need a roof looked at, new siding or a kitchen or bathroom remodel? Tell me about it and I'll help you get a free estimate or book a time.

about.headline: A family business that treats your house like our own.
about.body: Joe has spent 20 years in home remodeling and runs the business with his son Joey. You get honest advice on what your house actually needs, a fair price, and a family team that stays in touch from the first visit to the final walkthrough.

cards.title: Older homes that need a refresh
cards.body: New siding, gutters, windows and doors that keep the character of the house.

cards.title: Rooms you want to update
cards.body: Kitchens, bathrooms, flooring, interiors and custom decks.

about.closing: Not sure what the house needs? Tell us what you're seeing and we'll come take a look.

problems.headline: Finding an honest contractor around Birdsboro shouldn't be this hard.

points.title: Unreturned calls & slow estimates
points.body: You call around for a quote and wait weeks for anyone to come out.

points.title: Vague pricing & surprise costs
points.body: A price that climbs once the old roof or siding comes off.

points.title: Missed timelines
points.body: Crews that don't show when they said and a job that drags on.

points.title: Messy job sites
points.body: Old shingles, nails and siding scraps left in your yard.

problems.bridge: You shouldn't have to chase a contractor just to get a straight answer about your house.

solutions.headline: Outside and in, done properly by a family crew.

services.title: Roofing & roof repair
services.body: Roof repairs, leak fixes, coatings and full replacements, including porch and shed roofs.

services.title: Siding, gutters, windows & doors
services.body: New siding and shutters, siding repair, gutters, windows and doors, with samples brought to you so you can choose.

services.title: Kitchens, baths & interiors

process.headline: We look. Tell you honestly. Do it right.

steps.title: Request your free estimate
steps.body: Send a few details with the form or give us a call. A ZIP code and a rough idea of the job is plenty.

steps.title: Visit & honest assessment
steps.body: We get up on the ladder, look at what's really going on, and put the scope and price in writing.

steps.title: On time, kept informed
steps.body: We show up when we said we would, keep you posted on the work and the paperwork, and keep the job moving.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.body: We walk the finished work with you and clean up before we call it done.

why.headline: We're not here to upsell you. We're here to do it right.

realReviews.author: Michelle Fetter
realReviews.text: Joe was a pleasure to work with.   He did the sliding on our home, along with installing double doors and replaced the roof on our screened in porch.  We have an older home, Joe did a fantastic job at preserving the charm and characteristics.  He was aware of the details and listened to what we wanted.  Out of the 3 estimates we got, he was the most reasonable and the only one who actually brought samples for us.  He also took the time to explain the different styles and types of sliding.  We will definitely be using him for future projects.   We also appreciate his honesty and respect for us and our home.

realReviews.author: Patricia Layman
realReviews.text: It's so rare to find an honest contractor. I was a pleasant working with DePaulo Roofing. Joe is a down to earth guy who was the only one that gave me an estimate telling me I did not need a new roof, saving me $17-21,000. He was the only one to physically climb a ladder and walk around looking under the tiles to see what needed to be done. Not just stand on the patio holding a clipboard. And, his estimate was around $5000 less than another quote I got. I highly recommend him for your Roofing needs. I already have!!

realReviews.author: Earl Garman
realReviews.text:
Joe and his son were great to work with; they came when they said they would and the jobs were completed on time. They installed siding and shutters, and we are very happy with the results. Joe's price is reasonable and I will call him for future projects. We highly recommend him based on our experience.
Earl and Tarry

finalCta.headline: Ready to talk about your roof, siding or remodel?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a free written estimate before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward conversation about your project.

faq.a: Yes. Send the project through the form or give us a call. We'll come out, take a proper look, and give you a written estimate with the scope and price.

faq.q: Do I need a new roof, or can it be repaired?
faq.a: Often a repair is enough. We get up on the roof and check before we recommend anything, and we'll tell you honestly if a repair will do.
Yes, we're accredited, licensed and insured. Ask when you request your estimate and we'll send the details for your project.
We're based in Birdsboro and work in the surrounding area. Tell us where the house is and we'll let you know.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to set up a visit at a time that suits you.
